query: What level of FTE detail and one-time vs recurring cost breakdown is needed to produce realistic per-user marginal cost estimates at pilot and scale scenarios?

response.query: What level of FTE detail and one-time vs recurring cost breakdown is needed to produce realistic per-user marginal cost estimates at pilot and scale scenarios?
response.answer: To estimate per-user marginal costs, detailed FTE breakdown and clear distinction between one-time and recurring costs are essential. Focus on fixed and variable expenses for accurate pilot and scale projections.
